selection.bestFor: Boutique dental or specialty practices that want to feel approachable and premium — orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry, or holistic family practices where trust and calm are the primary emotional registers.

strategy.background: near-white page ground with a very faint warm-neutral outer chrome; hero section uses a full-bleed atmospheric photograph as its own background
strategy.surfaceStrategy: Single muted teal-green accent carries almost all interactive and emphasis work — logo, nav links, CTA button fill (on light pages), the second line of every split heading, large stat numerals, and toggle fills. Primary surfaces stay white or near-white. Photo cards use a semi-transparent tint of the same accent hue as an overlay. No secondary accent competes. Dark near-black is reserved for primary heading text only.

type.substitutionCriteria: Must be a transitional or contemporary editorial serif with high thick/thin stroke contrast, bracketed serifs, and slightly calligraphic terminals. Needs a true bold weight for display headings and a light/regular weight for body. Optical size should feel refined at large display sizes without becoming decorative. Tight natural tracking at display scale is essential.
type.pairing: Editorial serif for all display headings; a light humanist sans or geometric-clean sans for body copy, nav links, and UI labels — the contrast between the two weights and classifications is the core typographic engine.

heading.size: large — display scale, especially on hero and section intros
heading.emphasisDevice: color shift on key phrase — second line of split two-line headings rendered in the muted teal accent while the first line stays near-black; scale alone also used for single-line headings

reference.displayFace: appears to be a contemporary transitional editorial serif (e.g. Canela, Freight Display, or similar)
reference.bodyFace: appears to be a light geometric or humanist sans

button.character: Pill-radius filled button as primary CTA — teal fill with white text on light pages; white fill with dark text on the dark hero. A hairline outline variant appears on the hero. Generous horizontal padding, small uppercase tracked label text with a bullet dot suffix (e.g. 'BOOK A SESSION •'). Secondary CTA uses the same pill shape in a softer teal fill.

label.character: Small uppercase, widely tracked inline text used sparingly as section eyebrows — no pill or badge container, no icon. Appears left-aligned above or beside body paragraphs. Examples: 'SERVICES', 'BALANCE'.

sections: hero — full-bleed atmospheric portrait with large serif headline, body copy, and CTA
services-intro — split heading with toggle motif and introductory paragraph
services — portrait-orientation photo cards with teal overlay (treatment menu)
services-narrative — large editorial serif heading with decorative line-art and body copy
stats — oversized accent numerals with descriptor labels (trust signals / practice milestones)
full-bleed-dark-banner — macro nature photograph with line-art overlay

composition.hero: Full-bleed atmospheric portrait photograph of a patient or doctor fills the entire hero frame with a soft bokeh treatment and a warm-teal color cast. The frame has a medium corner radius (md) giving it a card-like quality set against the outer page chrome. Navigation sits inside the hero frame at the top. Large display serif headline ('A Smile That Shapes Your Confidence.') anchors bottom-left in white, spanning roughly 50% of the width at very large scale. Body copy and a pill CTA button ('START YOUR JOURNEY •') sit bottom-right in a separate text block. A thin single-stroke looping cursive line-art motif is overlaid on the photograph as a decorative layer — it is not interactive and does not contain text. The overall composition is asymmetric: headline weight is bottom-left, supporting copy is bottom-right.
composition.nav: Logo ('• practice—name') sits top-left with a small bullet dot prefix and an em-dash separator as a typographic brand mark. Nav links (ABOUT / SERVICES / STORIES / JOURNAL equivalent: ABOUT / SERVICES / PATIENTS / JOURNAL) are positioned center-right in small uppercase with generous tracking — not centered in the full viewport, but grouped right of center. A pill CTA button ('BOOK A SESSION •') sits at the far right. On the hero screen the entire nav is white (reversed out over the photograph). On white-background pages the logo and nav links render in the muted teal accent and the CTA button fills with teal. No visible divider line under the nav. No hamburger visible — desktop-only treatment in screenshots.
composition.footer: Footer is not visible in any screenshot. Inferred from the source's minimal, airy aesthetic: a minimal-dark footer is most coherent — a dark near-black ground (in the headingDark token range) with the logo mark reversed in white or light teal, a sparse single row of nav links in small uppercase tracking, and a brief legal line. No heavy column grid. A single pill CTA ('Book a Session') may appear as a final prompt. No social icon cluster or newsletter form inferred from the source's restraint.
composition.services: Four portrait-orientation photo cards arranged in a horizontal row with a staggered vertical offset — alternating cards sit slightly higher or lower creating a rhythmic cascade. Each card has a semi-transparent teal overlay on the photograph, white serif treatment title top-left, and white body descriptor text bottom-left. Cards have sm corner radius. In dental context: Preventive Care, Cosmetic Dentistry, Orthodontics, Restorative — each with an evocative close-up clinical or environmental photograph treated with the teal overlay.
composition.servicesIntro: A split two-line heading where line 1 is near-black serif ('There may not be a single answer,') and line 2 is teal serif ('but there are clear steps forward.'). Above the heading, a small inline uppercase label ('SERVICES') and a decorative toggle UI element labeled 'BALANCE' — the toggle is purely visual/metaphorical, not a functional filter in this context. Below the heading, a short centered body paragraph. This section sits on a white ground with generous vertical padding.
composition.stats: Four oversized teal accent numerals (e.g. '2,400+', '98%', '15+', '30+') arranged in a single horizontal row with generous spacing. Each numeral has a small dark body-weight descriptor label below it ('Patients treated', 'Satisfaction rate', 'Years of experience', 'Treatments offered'). No surrounding containers, borders, or cards — the numbers float on white. A split two-line heading above the row follows the same near-black / teal color-shift pattern.
composition.fullBleedBanner: A full-width atmospheric photograph (macro nature, sky, or abstract environmental) used as a section divider or transition between content sections. Sharp edges (no corner radius) — bleeds edge to edge within the page container. The thin looping line-art motif is overlaid on the photograph. In dental context: a serene sky, soft bokeh of a clean clinical space, or macro detail of natural material.

novel.name: Staggered Portrait Card Row
novel.spec: Four portrait-orientation photo cards in a horizontal row with alternating vertical offsets (cards 1 and 3 sit ~20px higher than cards 2 and 4, or vice versa). Each card: sm corner radius, full-bleed photograph, semi-transparent teal color overlay at ~60% opacity, white serif heading top-left at ~18–22px, white body text bottom-left at ~13px, no explicit CTA per card. The stagger creates visual rhythm without a grid. In dental context, cards map to primary treatment categories. Closest enum is card-grid but the stagger and portrait orientation are not captured by it.

novel.name: Oversized Accent Numeral Row
novel.spec: A horizontal row of 4 stat units. Each unit: an oversized teal numeral at ~72–96px in the display serif, a small dark descriptor label below at ~13px body weight. No containers, no icons, no borders. Units are evenly spaced with generous gutters. Preceded by a split two-line heading (near-black line 1 / teal line 2) and a short right-aligned supporting paragraph. Sits on white ground. No existing variant captures this bare numeral treatment.

novel.name: Split Heading with Decorative Toggle Motif
novel.spec: A centered section with a small inline uppercase label ('SERVICES') and a decorative toggle switch UI element labeled 'BALANCE' above the main heading — the toggle is visual/metaphorical only (not a functional filter). Below it, a two-line split heading: line 1 near-black serif, line 2 teal serif. Below the heading, a short centered body paragraph. The toggle motif is a unique emphasis device with no existing variant equivalent.

novel.name: Thin Cursive Stroke Overlay Motif
novel.spec: A single-stroke thin looping/cursive SVG line-art element overlaid on photographs and white sections as a recurring decorative layer. The stroke is approximately 1px, in the decorativeLine token color or white depending on background. It forms loose organic loops and figure-eight shapes — not iconographic, purely decorative. Appears on the hero, the services narrative section, and the dark stats banner. Requires an SVG overlay component that can be positioned absolutely over any section.

imagery.crop: Generous framing — subjects are not tightly cropped; environmental context is preserved. Portrait-orientation crops for service cards. Full-bleed landscape crops for banner sections. The hero image gives the subject substantial headroom and breathing room.
imagery.grading: Soft, slightly desaturated with a cool teal-green cast overall, occasionally warmed with a gentle golden-amber glow in highlight areas (particularly hero backgrounds). Blacks are lifted — no crushed shadows. The overall effect is luminous and hazy rather than crisp and clinical.
imagery.framing: Subjects (doctors, patients) are offset — not centered. Environmental and atmospheric context is kept in frame. Close-up macro details (an eye, a hand, a leaf) are used as abstract stand-ins for emotional states rather than literal clinical documentation.
imagery.subjectTreatment: Doctors and patients photographed in a soft, contemplative register — looking away from camera or in quiet repose rather than posed smiling directly at the lens. Clinic spaces shown as serene environments with natural light. Close-up details of hands, faces in profile, or environmental textures used to evoke care and calm rather than procedure. All images processed with the cool teal-green grade and lifted blacks to unify the palette.

voice.rhythm: Unhurried declaratives with reflective pauses — em-dashes used to extend a thought rather than truncate it. Headlines split across two lines with the emotional payload on the second line. Short body paragraphs of two to three sentences. Second-person address throughout. Numbers and milestones framed as shared achievements rather than credentials.
favors: journey and path metaphors translated to dental care context (e.g. 'your path to a healthier smile')
second-person warmth ('your goals, your pace, your needs')
plain-spoken verbs of forward motion ('move forward', 'take the next step')
reassuring qualifiers ('at your own pace', 'designed around you')
em-dash for reflective pauses in headlines and body copy
avoids: clinical procedure jargon as primary headline language
hard-sell urgency or discount language ('limited time', 'act now')

gaps.detail: Staggered portrait card row for services (card-grid enum does not capture the alternating vertical offset or portrait orientation with teal overlay)
Oversized accent numeral stats row has no existing variant — closest would be a custom stats section
Split heading with decorative toggle motif (services intro) has no existing variant
Thin cursive SVG line-art overlay motif (decorativeLineArt) is a recurring decorative layer with no existing variant — requires an SVG overlay component positionable absolutely over any section
Semi-transparent teal color overlay on photo cards requires a surface overlay token (opacity + tint) not expressible in the current flat color token system
Hero background warm-glow gradient (amber bleed into teal, referencing heroWarmGlow token) requires a gradient token for the atmospheric hero background treatment

fidelityChecks: Hero must be a full-bleed atmospheric photograph with the thin cursive line-art SVG overlay — removing the line-art motif loses a defining character element
Split two-line headings must render line 1 in near-black serif and line 2 in the muted teal accent — this color-shift emphasis device is the primary typographic identity marker
Service/treatment cards must use portrait orientation with a semi-transparent teal overlay on the photograph, not plain colored cards or icon tiles
Nav CTA button must be pill-radius with a bullet dot suffix character (e.g. 'BOOK A SESSION •') — the dot suffix is a recurring brand punctuation device
Headings carry no uppercase kicker by default; eyebrow labels appear only sparing (e.g. once per major section) as small inline uppercase tracked text — never as a badge or pill
Stat numerals must be oversized, in the teal accent, and float without surrounding containers or card borders
Full-bleed image banners (sky, macro nature) must appear as section transitions — they are structural rhythm elements, not decorative afterthoughts
Body copy and supporting text must remain light weight and small — the contrast between large bold serif headings and delicate body text is essential to the airy density
The logo mark must include the bullet dot prefix and em-dash separator as typographic elements (• practice—name format)
Page density must remain airy — generous vertical padding between sections; never compress sections to fit more content above the fold
